mapper.select: SELECT payment_id, payment_no, invoice_id, contract_id, order_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, payment_amount, payment_date, payment_method, bank_name, bank_account, payer, attachment, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_invoice_payment WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY payment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_invoice_payment ( payment_no, invoice_id, contract_id, order_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, payment_amount, payment_date, payment_method, bank_name, bank_account, payer, attachment, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{paymentNo}, #{invoiceId}, #{contractId}, #{orderId}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentDate}, #{paymentMethod}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{payer}, #{attachment}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment_amount), 0) FROM pms_invoice_payment WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND del_flag = '0'
